purpose.summary: COACTVWS is a CICS presentation-layer program for an Account View screen (transaction ALS9). It accepts an account ID from the user, calls the RPC program COACTVWL to retrieve account and customer data, and displays the results on a BMS map (COACTVW/CACTVWA). It handles navigation to/from menu, card list, card detail, and card update screens.

notable_features: EXEC CICS (BMS map send/receive, HANDLE ABEND, program LINK/XCTL)
RPC pattern: calls COACTVWL via CICS LINK passing WS-RPC-COMMAREA
BMS copybooks: DFHBMSCA, DFHAID, COACTVW mapset
Multiple COPY statements for common copybooks (COCOM01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSMSG02Y, CSUSR01Y, COTTL01Y, CVCRD01Y)
88-level condition names used extensively for flags and return codes
LINKAGE SECTION with DFHCOMMAREA using DEPENDING ON EIBCALEN
No EXEC SQL (pure CICS, no DB2 direct access in this program)
Amazon/AWS Apache 2.0 licensed (CardDemo open-source sample application)
